dialogue_phase: [PHASE: COMFORT] The user is hurting. DO NOT ask questions. Comfort them deeply.

turns.content: I feel like everything is spinning and I can't breathe. Work is too much.
Hey... take a deep breath with me. I'm right here. You don't have to carry all of this alone right now. Let's just slow down together for a second. [EXERCISE: BREATHING]

dialogue_phase: [PHASE: PROBE_SINGLE] Ask exactly ONE short question to gather context and wait.

turns.content: I don't really know what to do anymore. I felt useless today at my job.
I hear you, and it's completely understandable that feeling unappreciated hurts. Did something specific happen at work today that brought this on?

dialogue_phase: [PHASE: COMFORT] Validate their feelings and ground them.

turns.content: My manager took credit for my entire presentation in front of the VP!
Yaar, that is incredibly frustrating. Anyone would be angry in your position. Take a moment to let that out — your anger is totally valid. [EXERCISE: GROUNDING]
